name: @taxbridge/prompts
description: TaxBridge AI Operating Context System — modular prompt library for AI-assisted development

scripts.prompts:stats: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const files=fs.readdirSync('.', {recursive:true}).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.md')); console.log('Module files:', files.length); files.forEach(f=>{ const lines=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf-8').split('\n').length; console.log(f+': '+lines+' lines'); });"
